name: Logo
summary: The ByteSphere lockup as outlined SVG. Four forms, five tones. Use it everywhere the company name appears; never retype the name.
needs: put the brand name in a header
logo on a dark or colored background
props: px of the whole lockup, default 32
show TECHNOLOGIES, default true; drop it under 120px wide
snippet:
<Logo height={32} />
<Logo variant="mark" height={28} />
<Logo tone="white" height={36} />   {/* on Navy, Azure or Ink */}
a11y: role=img with aria-label. Wrap in a link to home with its own aria-label.

name: BrandMark
summary: Just the two-half mark, themeable or single-color (currentColor). Base of every brand loader.
a11y: Decorative unless `title` is passed.

name: Art (illustrations)
summary: Seven line illustrations in one style for empty and error states: folder, search, inbox, cloud, lock, chart, plug.

name: Appearance (useAppearance, AppearancePanel)
summary: One store for mode, eight named dark modes, four light pages, two accents, four corner styles, density and five navigation styles. Writes data-* attributes on <html>.
needs: let the user pick a dark theme
variants: dark: midnight · navy · ink · slate · ocean · dim · cobalt · dusk
nav: surface · tint · navy · ink · azure
a11y: Every named dark mode is contrast-checked (text 4.5:1, controls 3:1).

name: SideNav
summary: App sidebar. Groups, nested items, badges, collapse to a 64px rail with tooltips. Reads --nav-* so one data-nav value restyles it.
snippet: <SideNav groups={groups} current="customers" brand={<Logo height={26} tagline={false} />} collapsed={rail} onToggle={() => setRail(!rail)} />
a11y: <nav aria-label=Primary>, aria-current=page, tooltips in rail, aria-expanded on groups.

name: TopBar
summary: 56px bar with left, center and right slots. tone="nav" makes it follow the navigation style (navy or ink).
snippet: <TopBar left={<Logo height={26} tagline={false} />} center={<SearchTrigger label="Search" />} right={<Avatar id="u1" name="Mia Moreno" />} />

name: SiteHeader
summary: Marketing header: logo, links, optional mega menu, sign in and one primary action, mobile drawer.

name: EcomHeader
summary: Store header: dismissible announcement, search, account, wishlist, cart with count, category row with mega menu.

name: MegaMenu
summary: Multi-column panel with icon links and an optional featured card. Used inside SiteHeader and EcomHeader.
snippet: <MegaMenu columns={[{ title: "Platform", links: [{ label: "Deals", desc: "Track renewals", icon: FileText }] }]} />

name: BottomTabs
summary: Mobile bar for 3 to 5 destinations with badges. Respects the safe area. See 01-foundations/mobile.md for when to use it versus a drawer.
a11y: 44px targets, aria-current.

name: Tabs · PillTabs · VerticalTabs · SubNav · Segmented
summary: Five switchers: underline tabs for views, pills for filters, segmented for view modes, vertical tabs for settings, SubNav for a secondary rail.
snippet:
<Tabs label="Sections" value={t} onChange={setT} items={[{id:"a",label:"Overview"}]} />
<Segmented label="View" items={["List","Board"]} value={v} onChange={setV} />
<PillTabs label="Status" value={s} onChange={setS} items={[{id:"all",label:"All",count:48}]} />
a11y: Arrow keys, Home, End. Roving tabindex.

name: Breadcrumb · Pagination · Stepper
summary: Location trail, numbered pagination with rows-per-page, and a step indicator for wizards.
snippet:
<Breadcrumb items={[{label:"Deals",href:"#"},{label:"Wingtip"}]} />
<Pagination page={p} pages={26} total={1284} size={50} onPage={setP} />
<Stepper steps={["Basics","Team","Review"]} current={1} />

name: GlobalBar
summary: Apple-style slim bar with full-width flyouts. Opens on hover intent (120ms) or focus, dims the page, staggers links in, closes on Esc. Search overlay and mobile accordion included.
snippet: <GlobalBar items={items} tone="light" right={<Button size="sm" variant="primary">Start free</Button>} />
a11y: Disclosure pattern: buttons with aria-expanded, Left/Right between items, Down opens, Esc closes and keeps focus.

name: MarketplaceHeader
summary: Amazon/Walmart-style header for large catalogs: utility row (deliver-to, language, account flyout, orders, cart), category-scoped search with typeahead, department strip with an All button that opens a drill-down drawer.
a11y: Search is role=search with combobox; typeahead supports arrows, Enter, Esc.

name: DepartmentDrawer
summary: Two-level drill-down drawer (root list, then a department's groups) with slide transitions and a back row. The mobile menu for any large site.
a11y: role=dialog aria-modal, Esc closes, focus moves to Close.

name: PlatformBar · AppLauncher · AccountPanel · Popover
summary: Meta-style bar: logo, search pill, five icon tabs with badges and an animated active bar, app launcher grid, chats, notifications, and an account panel.
a11y: Popovers are dialogs with aria-expanded triggers; Esc returns focus.

name: CategoryTree
summary: Expandable category tree with counts, for category pages and filters.

name: SurfaceCard
summary: One card with eight surface styles. Pick one style per layout.

name: Glass
summary: The only place blur and transparency are allowed: a card laid over a brand backdrop, or a sticky bar over content. Includes its own backdrop so contrast is checkable.
a11y: Text must keep 4.5:1 against the worst backdrop. Opacity never below 55%.

name: Rectangle cards
summary: Eight layouts: media left/right/top, wide banner, portrait, header-strip, icon, add-new action, list, profile.
needs: card with image on the side
snippet:
<MediaCard side="left" icon={Zap} title="Faster approvals" body="Route by amount." />
<BannerCard tone="brand" title="Upgrade" body="…" cta="See plans" />
<ProfileCard id="u5" name="Priya Raghavan" role="Finance" stats={[["Deals","42"]]} />

name: Backdrop
summary: Absolute background layer: solid, tint, navy, ink, brand fills; SVG grid, dots, lines, rings, waves; CSS-only stripes and checks.
a11y: aria-hidden. Marketing, auth, empty states and banners only; never behind tables, forms or charts.

name: SiteFooter
summary: Six footers: columns, simple, minimal, newsletter, navy, app bar.

name: Button
summary: Six variants, five sizes, loading with the brand mark, and disabled-with-reason.
props: makes it aria-disabled and shows the reason as a tooltip
snippet:
<Button variant="primary" loading={saving}>Save changes</Button>
<Button reason="Only admins can invite">Invite</Button>
<Button size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label="Delete"><Trash2 /></Button>
a11y: One primary per view. Icon-only needs aria-label.

name: Field · Input · Textarea · Select
summary: Label above, helper and error slots, start/end adornments, validation shake.
props: Field: id, label, hint, error, optional
children is a render function receiving aria props
snippet: <Field id="email" label="Work email" error={err} hint="Invoices go here">{(p) => <Input {...p} type="email" autoComplete="email" start={<Mail />} />}</Field>
a11y: aria-invalid and aria-describedby wired by Field.

name: Checkbox · Switch · Radio
summary: Selection controls with hint text; checkbox supports indeterminate.
snippet:
<Checkbox id="a" label="Weekly summary" hint="Mondays" checked={v} onChange={setV} />
<Switch id="s" label="Email alerts" checked={on} onChange={setOn} />

name: Combobox · TagInput · Slider · Dropzone
summary: Searchable select, multi-email chips, labelled range, and a drag-and-drop uploader with per-file progress and errors.
snippet:
<Combobox id="c" options={countries} value={v} onChange={setV} />
<TagInput id="t" label="Invite" value={emails} onChange={setEmails} />
<Dropzone />

name: SettingsRow
summary: Two-column settings row: title and description left, controls right.

name: StatusPill · Count · FilterTag · Kbd
summary: Status words in tinted 4px rectangles, count badges, removable filter chips, keyboard hints.
variants: tones: success warning danger info neutral
snippet:
<StatusPill tone="danger">Past due</StatusPill>
<Count n={4} />
<FilterTag k="Status" v="Active" onRemove={…} />
a11y: The word carries the meaning; color is secondary.

name: Banner
summary: Four tones. Full-width at the page top or as an inline callout. One at a time.
snippet: <Banner tone="warning" title="Card declined" action={<Button size="sm">Update</Button>}>Update it by 14 Mar.</Banner>
a11y: role=alert for danger, status otherwise.

name: Toast (ToastProvider, useToast)
summary: Bottom-right, max 3, errors persist with an action, 5s for the rest.
snippet:
const toast = useToast();
toast({ tone: "success", title: "Saved", action: { label: "Undo", onClick } });
a11y: Live region; never for decisions or validation.

name: Modal · Drawer
summary: Native <dialog> with focus trap, Esc, and return focus. Modal for 3 fields or fewer, Drawer for side tasks.
snippet: <Modal open={o} onClose={() => setO(false)} title="Delete report?" description="This can't be undone." danger footer={<><Button>Cancel</Button><Button variant="danger">Delete report</Button></>} />

name: Menu · Tooltip
summary: Keyboard menu with groups, shortcuts and a danger item last. Tooltip on hover and focus with a 500ms delay.
snippet:
<Menu label="Actions" trigger={<Ellipsis />} items={[{label:"Edit"}, "sep", {label:"Delete…", danger:true}]} />
<Tooltip text="Delete invoice"><Button size="icon" aria-label="Delete invoice"><Trash2/></Button></Tooltip>
a11y: Arrow keys, Home, End, Esc returns focus.

name: StatePanel
summary: Empty, error and no-results panel with art, one action and a reference id.
snippet: <StatePanel art={<Art.search />} title="No deals match" description="Clear a filter." action={<Button>Clear filters</Button>} />

name: Brand loaders
summary: Loaders built from the mark. Swirl for content, Split for background work, Trace for inline, Orbit and Bloom for waiting states, Fill for known progress, a route bar and a boot screen.
a11y: role=status or progressbar with text.

name: SkeletonKit
summary: Twelve shaped skeletons with four animations (pulse, wave, static, mark).
variants: text avatar card table chart list media form kpi profile product dashboard
a11y: role=status, aria-busy. Show after 150ms.

name: Progress family
summary: Eleven forms of progress: linear (4 sizes, 5 tones), segmented, steps, stacked, ring, half ring, bullet, goal, buffer, indeterminate.
props: ProgressBar: value, max, label, size, tone, showValue
ProgressRing: value, size, stroke, tone, center
snippet:
<ProgressBar label="Storage" value={41} max={100} showValue />
<ProgressRing value={72} label="Coverage" />
<ProgressGoal label="Revenue" value={412000} goal={500000} />
a11y: role=progressbar with value and label.

name: StatTile
summary: Eight ways to show one KPI with delta and period.
snippet: <StatTile style="spark" label="Net revenue" value="$46.2K" delta="4.2%" data={series} />
a11y: Delta uses arrow plus sign plus color.

name: Charts
summary: Token-colored SVG charts with tabular numbers and text alternatives. Heavy datasets use ECharts instead.
snippet:
<LineChart labels={days} yMax={60} series={[{ name: "This period", data, color: "var(--color-data-1)" }]} />
<Funnel stages={[{label:"Visited",value:12400}]} />
a11y: role=img with a label; provide a table view for dense data.

name: Timeline · DescList · CodeBlock · Accordion
summary: Activity feed, key-value list, copyable code, and an accordion.
snippet:
<Timeline items={[{ who: "Priya", what: "moved the deal", when: "Today" }]} />
<DescList items={[["Owner","Priya"]]} />
<CodeBlock lang="bash" code="curl …" />

name: PageHeader
summary: Title, description, breadcrumbs or back link, meta row and right-aligned actions. One primary action.
snippet: <PageHeader title="Deals" desc="Renewals and expansions." actions={<Button variant="primary">New deal</Button>} />

name: Avatar · AvatarGroup
summary: Initials with a deterministic color from the user id, presence dot, square variant for organizations.

name: ProductCard
summary: Five product card layouts with rating, badge, swatches, wishlist and quick add.

name: ProductArt
summary: SVG product illustrations (bottle, headphones, chair, lamp, bag, watch) in four tones, so catalogs render without photo assets.

name: Price · Rating · Swatches · QuantityStepper
summary: Small store parts: price with discount, star rating, color swatches, quantity stepper.
snippet:
<Price price={189} was={249} />
<Rating value={4.6} count={389} />
<QuantityStepper value={q} onChange={setQ} />

name: CartLine · OrderSummary · FilterPanel
summary: Cart row, order summary with promo code, catalog filter panel, and a tiny cart store.
snippet:
const { lines, subtotal } = useCart();
<OrderSummary subtotal={subtotal} shipping={0} tax={subtotal*.08} cta={<Button variant="primary">Checkout</Button>} />

name: OrderTimeline · ReviewItem
summary: Vertical order tracking with done, current and upcoming states; review item.

name: StatusScreen
summary: One full-page component that renders any of 50 system pages (404, 500, 503, 429, session expired, payment failed, maintenance, offline and more) from data in src/data/status.ts. Includes code pill, headline, actions, countdown and developer notes with an RFC 9457 body.
props: an entry from statuses; find by slug
render inside the app shell instead of full page
a11y: Title is {code} {name}; focus moves to h1; countdown announces at start and end only.

name: NotificationCenter · NotificationList · NotificationItem
summary: Bell with unread count that opens a 400px panel with All, Unread and Mentions tabs, mark all read and per-item actions. The store hook keeps read and dismiss state.
props: optional; share one store with a full page
snippet:
const n = useNotifications();
<TopBar right={<NotificationCenter store={n} onViewAll={() => go('/notifications')} />} />
a11y: Trigger names the unread count; Escape closes; items are a list; unread dot has a label.

name: NotificationPrefs · PushPreview · EmailPreview
summary: Channel matrix (in app, email, push) per category with security email locked on, plus lock-screen push and email previews for designing copy.
a11y: Each switch is labelled with category and channel.

name: OtpInput
summary: Six-box one-time code. Auto-advance, Backspace goes back, arrows move, paste fills every box, autocomplete=one-time-code, shakes on error.
a11y: Group label plus Digit n labels.

name: RatingInput
summary: 1 to 5 star radio group with hover preview, arrow keys, click again to clear.
a11y: Radio group, each star named.

name: DateRangePicker
summary: Month grid with start and end selection, hover preview, presets (7 days, this week, 30 days) and a live summary line.
a11y: Days are buttons with aria-pressed; summary is a live region.

name: AnimatedNumber · Typewriter · Reveal
summary: Count a KPI up once, type a line out once, fade content in on scroll. All skip animation under reduced motion and give screen readers the final text.
a11y: Typewriter keeps full text in sr-only.

name: TiltCard · SpotlightCard · FlipCard
summary: Three hover or tap surfaces: tilt toward pointer (6 degrees max), brand glow that follows the cursor, and a two-sided flip. Marketing and showcase surfaces only.
a11y: Flip is a toggle button; tilt is skipped on touch and reduced motion.

name: RippleButton
summary: Primary button with a tap-point ripple. Use for the single most important touch action.
a11y: Normal button semantics.

name: SpeedDial · SplitButton
summary: A floating create button that fans out 3 to 5 labelled actions, and a split button with a default action plus a menu of alternatives.
snippet:
<SpeedDial actions={[{ label: 'New deal', icon: FileText }]} />
<SplitButton label="Save" options={[{ label: 'Save and close' }]} />
a11y: aria-expanded on both; menu closes on Escape.

name: HoverCard · ContextMenuArea
summary: Rich preview on hover or focus (300 ms delay) and a right-click or long-press menu. Both must have a visible equivalent.
a11y: Hover card opens on focus too; menu role=menu.

name: Carousel · LogoMarquee
summary: Scroll-snap carousel with arrows and dots that never auto-advances, and a pausing logo loop with edge fade.
a11y: carousel and slide roles; marquee stops under reduced motion.

name: CompareSlider · ResizableSplit
summary: Before and after reveal slider, and a two-pane layout with a draggable, keyboard-operable divider.
a11y: Both dividers are focusable with arrow keys and expose values.

name: SortableList
summary: Drag to reorder with a handle, plus Alt+Arrow keyboard moves and a live announcement.
a11y: Handle is a button; position is announced.

name: ReactionBar · StreakBadge · Achievement
summary: Icon reactions with count pop, a streak chip, and a claimable achievement card that fires brand confetti. Confetti is rare: one per session.
a11y: Reactions are toggles with counts in the name; confetti is aria-hidden and skipped on reduced motion.

name: Tour
summary: First-run walkthrough: dims the page, rings a target by CSS selector, 3 to 5 steps, Back, Next, Escape to skip.
snippet: <Tour open={on} onClose={off} steps={[{ target: '#new', title: 'Create', body: '...' }]} />
a11y: Dialog with arrow-key navigation.

name: ColorSwatchPicker · MentionInput
summary: Brand-color radio swatches with check mark, and a comment box that suggests people after @ with arrow and Enter selection.
a11y: Swatches are radios; suggestions are a listbox.

name: More loaders (L-10 to L-18)
summary: Nine specific-purpose loaders: inline dots, processing bars, radar for search or scan, small ring, shimmer text for AI waits, typing indicator, sync grid, determinate ring and rotating status messages.
a11y: All have role=status or progressbar; reduced motion falls back to a pulse.

name: DataTable
summary: Reference table: search, sortable headers with aria-sort, row and page selection with indeterminate state, bulk action slot, paging, empty-search state.
a11y: Header buttons announce sort; checkboxes labelled.

name: KanbanDnD
summary: Columns of cards moved by drag and drop, with a Move select on every card so touch and keyboard work. Announces moves.
a11y: Move select labelled per card; live region reports moves.

name: TreeView
summary: Nested folder tree with arrow-key navigation, expand and collapse, selection.
a11y: role=tree, aria-expanded, roving tabindex.

name: ChatThread
summary: Messaging UI: log with auto-scroll, composer (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline), typing indicator, optional auto-reply for demos.
a11y: role=log with polite live region.

name: EditableText · PasswordField
summary: Click-to-edit text (Enter saves, Escape cancels) and a new-password field with show/hide, 4-step strength meter and live rule checklist.
a11y: Strength and rules are announced; toggle is aria-pressed.

name: RangeSlider
summary: Dual-thumb min and max slider with keyboard steps (Shift = 10) and a readout.
a11y: Two role=slider thumbs with valuenow.

name: MarkdownEditor
summary: Notes editor with toolbar buttons that insert syntax and a live side-by-side preview (headings, bold, italic, lists, code, links).
a11y: Toolbar role, labelled textarea and preview.

name: SignaturePad · ColorPicker
summary: Pointer or touch signature canvas with clear, and an HSL color picker with hex output and copy.
a11y: Canvas is labelled; sliders are native ranges.

name: SearchWithRecents
summary: Combobox search: recent searches on focus, highlighted matches, arrow and Enter selection, Clear recents.
a11y: role=combobox with listbox; Escape closes.

name: SwipeRow · PullToRefresh · InfiniteList · VirtualList
summary: Mobile list behaviours: swipe-to-reveal action, pull-to-refresh, infinite scroll with skeletons, and a virtualized list of 10,000 rows.
a11y: Every gesture has a button equivalent.

name: LiveChart · Gauge · ContributionHeatmap · Timer
summary: Streaming line with pause, semi-circle gauge with thresholds, 5-step activity heatmap with tooltip, and a start/pause/reset timer.
a11y: Charts have text labels; timer role=timer.

name: Poll · Lightbox
summary: Vote with animated result bars (changeable), and a full-screen gallery with arrows, Escape and focus return.
a11y: Fieldset legend; dialog with focus return.

name: ScannerPanel · ScanFeed · DeviceRow
summary: Barcode and QR scanner viewfinder with corner brackets and the scan-line recipe, live scan feed with Flash on arrival, and device status rows.
variants: states: idle scanning success error paused
snippet:
<ScannerPanel state={state} kind={kind} onKind={setKind} onToggle={toggle} onSimulate={add} last={scans[0]} />
<ScanFeed scans={scans} />
a11y: Status text in a live region; success and error never rely on color alone.

name: Card · CardHeader
summary: The default container: raised surface, 1px border, padding 20. CardHeader adds a title, description and one action.
props: hover and focus style for clickable cards
snippet:
<Card>
  <CardHeader title="Members" desc="People with access." action={<Button size="sm">Invite</Button>} />
  ...
</Card>
a11y: Not a landmark. Put a heading inside when the card names a section.

name: Skeleton
summary: One placeholder block. Compose several to match the final layout; shown after 150ms so quick loads do not flash.
props: size and shape, e.g. h-4 w-32
default true; off under reduced motion
a11y: aria-hidden. The container announces loading with aria-busy.

name: Progress
summary: Determinate progress bar with a required label and optional value text.
snippet: <Progress label="Storage used" value={72} valueText="7.2 of 10 GB" />
a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, label required.

name: Stat
summary: KPI tile: label, value, change with direction, period and optional sparkline. Has a loading state.
props: colors the change; direction is also an arrow
snippet: <Stat label="Revenue" value="$48.2k" delta="+8.1%" good period="vs last month" />
a11y: Change is text plus arrow, never color alone.

name: Label · Overline
summary: Small caption styles for grouping headings in dense screens.
a11y: Text only. Use a real heading when it names a region.

name: Specimen
summary: Titled frame used in the showcase to present one example next to its doc reference.
needs: show a component example in docs

name: BackToTop · ScrollProgress
summary: A button that appears after 600px of scroll and a thin reading-progress bar for long pages.
a11y: BackToTop is a real button with a label; motion respects reduced-motion.

name: NotifBadge
summary: Count pill for unread items; hides at 0 and caps at 99+.
a11y: Pair with text such as "12 unread" for screen readers on the parent control.
